metadata.name: routed-smoke
metadata.description: End-to-end proof that test-genie's routed test-database path actually works: navigates to the goldens index served by the live scenario, and asserts that the slug seeded into the per-run test pool ('routed-smoke-001') is rendered in the list. The slug exists only in the test pool; if the API failed to route the request to the test pool (e.g., X-Vrooli-Test-Mode header not attached, TestModeMiddleware missing, RoutedDB.pick(ctx) returning the primary), the assertion fails.

assert.failure_message: Seeded golden 'routed-smoke-001' not visible in the goldens list — the UI→API request did not reach the routed test pool. Check that X-Vrooli-Test-Mode is being attached by Playwright (browser_profile.extra_headers), that TestModeMiddleware is mounted, and that the goldens repository uses *database.RoutedDB.

metadata.label: Assert seeded golden slug is rendered (proves routing end-to-end)
